findings.description:
cacheget iterates {base+
*, base+
+enc}; the store at 78 writes * when there is no Vary. Widening holds for every differing AE. Because wildcard is probed before exact, an installed wildcard makes a valid exact entry unreachable, which a4ba853a does not do (exact first). That ordering difference is a driveable row, not a hypothesis.
findings.title: Second, independent wildcard store, and it probes the wildcard FIRST so an installed wildcard shadows a correct exact entry

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host

scope: Consumer-parity: whether each build s RCE is still an executing request when the upstream is stock software (nginx + FastCGI, node 22 / llhttp, python http.server) instead of a hand-written peer. Execution is always on the upstream host; the proxy never executes.
